Left: ten squares per driver (5 seeds Sonnet 5.5, 5 seeds GPT-6.2 Sol). Right: Claude Sonnet 5.5 median
wall time (including tool calls, log scale, further left is faster). Hollow dot: fewer than 3 of 5 passed.
Foreground drag lock / AT-SPI / turn-limit failure
